text_ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum

translations.en: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.tr: Allah, O'ndan başka ilâh yoktur; O, hayydır, kayyûmdur.
translations.ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.es: Allah dice: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.fr: Allah dit: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.

text_ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۞ إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
transliteration: Fa inna ma'al-'usri yusra. Inna ma'al-'usri yusra

translations.en: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.tr: Şüphesiz zorlukla beraber bir kolaylık vardır.
translations.ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۞ إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.de: Allah sagt: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.es: Allah dice: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.fr: Allah dit: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.zh: 安拉说: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

text_ar: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
transliteration: Ala bidhikrillahi tatma'innul-qulub

translations.en: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.tr: Bilesiniz ki, kalpler ancak Allah'ı anmakla huzur bulur.
translations.ar: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.es: Allah dice: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.fr: Allah dit: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

text_ar: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
transliteration: Fadhkuruni adhkurkum washkuru li wa la takfurun

translations.en: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.tr: Öyleyse beni anın ki ben de sizi anayım.
translations.ar: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.de: Allah sagt: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.es: Allah dice: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.fr: Allah dit: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.zh: 安拉说: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

text_ar: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۞ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
transliteration: Wa man yattaqillaha yaj'al lahu makhraja

translations.en: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.tr: Kim Allah'a karşı gelmekten sakınırsa, Allah ona bir çıkış yolu ihsan eder.
translations.ar: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۞ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.de: Allah sagt: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.es: Allah dice: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.fr: Allah dit: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.zh: 安拉说: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.

text_ar: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Qul ya 'ibadiyal-ladhina asrafu 'ala anfusihim la taqnatu min rahmatillah

translations.en: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.tr: De ki: Ey kendi aleyhlerine olarak haddi aşan kullarım! Allah'ın rahmetinden ümidinizi kesmeyin.
translations.ar: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.de: Allah sagt: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.es: Allah dice: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.fr: Allah dit: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.zh: 安拉说: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

text_ar: وَلاَ تَهِنُوا وَلاَ تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa la tahinu wa la tahzanu wa antumul-a'lawna in kuntum mu'minin

translations.en: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.tr: Gevşemeyin, hüzünlenmeyin. Eğer inanıyorsanız en üstün olan sizlersiniz.
translations.ar: وَلاَ تَهِنُوا وَلاَ تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.es: Allah dice: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.fr: Allah dit: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.

text_ar: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ
transliteration: La'in shakartum la-azidannakum wa la'in kafartum inna 'adhabi lashadid

translations.en: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.tr: Andolsun ki, eğer şükrederseniz elbette size nimetimi artırırım.
translations.ar: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.de: Allah sagt: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.es: Allah dice: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.fr: Allah dit: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.zh: 安拉说: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.

text_ar: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
transliteration: Wa idha sa'alaka 'ibadi 'anni fa-inni qarib, ujibu da'watad-da'i idha da'an

translations.en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.tr: Kullarım sana beni sorduklarında şüphesiz ben yakınım. Dua edenin duasına icabet ederim.
translations.ar: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.de: Allah sagt: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.es: Allah dice: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.fr: Allah dit: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.zh: 安拉说: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.

text_ar: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ
transliteration: Innamal-mu'minunal-ladhina idha dhukirallahu wajilat qulubuhum

translations.en: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.tr: Müminler ancak o kimselerdir ki, Allah anıldığı zaman kalpleri titrer.
translations.ar: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.de: Allah sagt: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.es: Allah dice: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.fr: Allah dit: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.zh: 安拉说: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.

text_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَى
transliteration: Innallaha ya'muru bil-'adli wal-ihsani wa ita'i dhil-qurba

translations.en: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.tr: Şüphesiz Allah, adaleti, iyilik yapmayı, yakınlara yardım etmeyi emreder.
translations.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَى
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.es: Allah dice: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.fr: Allah dit: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.

text_ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada

translations.en: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.tr: Rabbimiz! Bize katından bir rahmet ver ve bizim için şu işimizden bir kurtuluş yolu hazırla.
translations.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.es: Allah dice: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.fr: Allah dit: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

text_ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي ۞ وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي ۞ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي ۞ يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
transliteration: Rabbish-rah li sadri wa yassir li amri wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawli

translations.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.tr: Rabbim! Göğsümü genişlet, işimi kolaylaştır, dilimdeki düğümü çöz ki sözümü anlasınlar.
translations.ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي ۞ وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي ۞ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي ۞ يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.de: Allah sagt: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.es: Allah dice: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.fr: Allah dit: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.zh: 安拉说: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.

text_ar: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa Anta Subhanaka inni kuntu minadh-dhalimin

translations.en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.tr: Senden başka ilâh yoktur. Seni tenzih ederim. Ben gerçekten zalimlerden oldum.
translations.ar: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.de: Allah sagt: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.es: Allah dice: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.fr: Allah dit: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

translations.zh: 安拉说: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

text_ar: اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ
transliteration: Allahu nurus-samawati wal-ard

translations.en: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
translations.tr: Allah, göklerin ve yerin nurudur.
translations.ar: اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.

text_ar: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ هَوْنًا
transliteration: Wa 'ibadur-Rahmanil-ladhina yamshuna 'alal-ardi hawna

translations.en: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.tr: Rahmân'ın kulları, yeryüzünde mütevazı bir şekilde yürüyen kimselerdir.
translations.ar: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ هَوْنًا
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.de: Allah sagt: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.es: Allah dice: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.

translations.zh: 安拉说: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.

text_ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir

translations.en: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
translations.tr: Rabbim! Doğrusu bana indireceğin her hayra muhtacım.
translations.ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.

translations.de: Allah sagt: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
translations.es: Allah dice: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
translations.zh: 安拉说: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.

text_ar: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا
transliteration: Wal-ladhina jahadu fina lanahdiyannahum subulana

translations.en: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.
translations.tr: Bizim uğrumuzda cihat edenleri elbette kendi yollarımıza eriştireceğiz.
translations.ar: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.
translations.de: Allah sagt: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.

translations.zh: 安拉说: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.

text_ar: يَا بُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا أَصَابَكَ
transliteration: Ya bunayya aqimis-salata wa'mur bil-ma'rufi wanha 'anil-munkari wasbir 'ala ma asabak

translations.en: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.
translations.tr: Yavrum! Namazı kıl, iyiliği emret, kötülükten vazgeçirmeye çalış ve başına gelene sabret.
translations.ar: يَا بُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا أَصَابَكَ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.
translations.de: Allah sagt: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.
translations.es: Allah dice: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.

translations.id: Allah berfirman: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.
translations.zh: 安拉说: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.

text_ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ
transliteration: Innal-ladhina qalu Rabbunallahu thummas-taqamu tatanazzalu 'alayhimul-mala'ikah

translations.en: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.
translations.tr: Şüphesiz 'Rabbimiz Allah'tır' deyip sonra da dosdoğru olanların üzerine melekler iner.
translations.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.
translations.es: Allah dice: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.

translations.id: Allah berfirman: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.

text_ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum

translations.en: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.tr: Allah, O'ndan başka ilâh yoktur; O, hayydır, kayyûmdur.
translations.ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.

translations.ru: Аллах сказал: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.

text_ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۞ إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
transliteration: Fa inna ma'al-'usri yusra. Inna ma'al-'usri yusra

translations.en: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.tr: Şüphesiz zorlukla beraber bir kolaylık vardır.
translations.ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۞ إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

translations.zh: 安拉说: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

text_ar: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
transliteration: Ala bidhikrillahi tatma'innul-qulub

translations.en: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.tr: Bilesiniz ki, kalpler ancak Allah'ı anmakla huzur bulur.
translations.ar: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.es: Allah dice: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.fr: Allah dit: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

text_ar: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
transliteration: Fadhkuruni adhkurkum washkuru li wa la takfurun

translations.en: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.tr: Öyleyse beni anın ki ben de sizi anayım.
translations.ar: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

translations.fr: Allah dit: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.zh: 安拉说: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

text_ar: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۞ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
transliteration: Wa man yattaqillaha yaj'al lahu makhraja

translations.en: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.tr: Kim Allah'a karşı gelmekten sakınırsa, Allah ona bir çıkış yolu ihsan eder.
translations.ar: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۞ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.de: Allah sagt: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.es: Allah dice: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.fr: Allah dit: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.

translations.ru: Аллах сказал: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.zh: 安拉说: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.

text_ar: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Qul ya 'ibadiyal-ladhina asrafu 'ala anfusihim la taqnatu min rahmatillah

translations.en: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.tr: De ki: Ey kendi aleyhlerine olarak haddi aşan kullarım! Allah'ın rahmetinden ümidinizi kesmeyin.
translations.ar: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.de: Allah sagt: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.es: Allah dice: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.fr: Allah dit: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.zh: 安拉说: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

text_ar: وَلاَ تَهِنُوا وَلاَ تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa la tahinu wa la tahzanu wa antumul-a'lawna in kuntum mu'minin

translations.en: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.tr: Gevşemeyin, hüzünlenmeyin. Eğer inanıyorsanız en üstün olan sizlersiniz.
translations.ar: وَلاَ تَهِنُوا وَلاَ تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.es: Allah dice: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.fr: Allah dit: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.

text_ar: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ
transliteration: La'in shakartum la-azidannakum wa la'in kafartum inna 'adhabi lashadid

translations.en: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.tr: Andolsun ki, eğer şükrederseniz elbette size nimetimi artırırım.
translations.ar: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.de: Allah sagt: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.es: Allah dice: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.fr: Allah dit: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.zh: 安拉说: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.

text_ar: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
transliteration: Wa idha sa'alaka 'ibadi 'anni fa-inni qarib, ujibu da'watad-da'i idha da'an

translations.en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.tr: Kullarım sana beni sorduklarında şüphesiz ben yakınım. Dua edenin duasına icabet ederim.

text_ar: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ
transliteration: Innamal-mu'minunal-ladhina idha dhukirallahu wajilat qulubuhum

translations.en: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.tr: Müminler ancak o kimselerdir ki, Allah anıldığı zaman kalpleri titrer.
translations.ar: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ

translations.zh: 安拉说: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.

text_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَى
transliteration: Innallaha ya'muru bil-'adli wal-ihsani wa ita'i dhil-qurba

translations.en: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.tr: Şüphesiz Allah, adaleti, iyilik yapmayı, yakınlara yardım etmeyi emreder.
translations.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَى

text_ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada

translations.en: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.tr: Rabbimiz! Bize katından bir rahmet ver ve bizim için şu işimizden bir kurtuluş yolu hazırla.
translations.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

text_ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي ۞ وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي ۞ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي ۞ يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
transliteration: Rabbish-rah li sadri wa yassir li amri wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawli

translations.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.tr: Rabbim! Göğsümü genişlet, işimi kolaylaştır, dilimdeki düğümü çöz ki sözümü anlasınlar.
translations.ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي ۞ وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي ۞ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي ۞ يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.de: Allah sagt: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.

translations.zh: 安拉说: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.

text_ar: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa Anta Subhanaka inni kuntu minadh-dhalimin

translations.en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.tr: Senden başka ilâh yoktur. Seni tenzih ederim. Ben gerçekten zalimlerden oldum.
translations.ar: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

translations.zh: 安拉说: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

text_ar: اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ
transliteration: Allahu nurus-samawati wal-ard

translations.en: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
translations.tr: Allah, göklerin ve yerin nurudur.
translations.ar: اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.

text_ar: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ هَوْنًا
transliteration: Wa 'ibadur-Rahmanil-ladhina yamshuna 'alal-ardi hawna

translations.en: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.tr: Rahmân'ın kulları, yeryüzünde mütevazı bir şekilde yürüyen kimselerdir.
translations.ar: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ هَوْنًا
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.de: Allah sagt: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.

translations.zh: 安拉说: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.

text_ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir

translations.en: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
translations.tr: Rabbim! Doğrusu bana indireceğin her hayra muhtacım.
translations.ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ

translations.zh: 安拉说: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.

text_ar: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا
transliteration: Wal-ladhina jahadu fina lanahdiyannahum subulana

translations.en: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.
translations.tr: Bizim uğrumuzda cihat edenleri elbette kendi yollarımıza eriştireceğiz.
translations.ar: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.

translations.zh: 安拉说: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.

text_ar: يَا بُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا أَصَابَكَ
transliteration: Ya bunayya aqimis-salata wa'mur bil-ma'rufi wanha 'anil-munkari wasbir 'ala ma asabak

translations.en: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.
translations.tr: Yavrum! Namazı kıl, iyiliği emret, kötülükten vazgeçirmeye çalış ve başına gelene sabret.
translations.ar: يَا بُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا أَصَابَكَ

translations.zh: 安拉说: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.

text_ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ
transliteration: Innal-ladhina qalu Rabbunallahu thummas-taqamu tatanazzalu 'alayhimul-mala'ikah

translations.en: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.
translations.tr: Şüphesiz 'Rabbimiz Allah'tır' deyip sonra da dosdoğru olanların üzerine melekler iner.
translations.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.

translations.de: Allah sagt: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.

translations.zh: 安拉说: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.

text_ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum

translations.en: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.tr: Allah, O'ndan başka ilâh yoktur; O, hayydır, kayyûmdur.
translations.ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.

translations.zh: 安拉说: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.

transliteration: Fa inna ma'al-'usri yusra. Inna ma'al-'usri yusra

translations.en: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.tr: Şüphesiz zorlukla beraber bir kolaylık vardır.
translations.ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۞ إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.zh: 安拉说: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

text_ar: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
transliteration: Ala bidhikrillahi tatma'innul-qulub

translations.en: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.tr: Bilesiniz ki, kalpler ancak Allah'ı anmakla huzur bulur.
translations.ar: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

text_ar: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
transliteration: Fadhkuruni adhkurkum washkuru li wa la takfurun

translations.en: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.tr: Öyleyse beni anın ki ben de sizi anayım.
translations.ar: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.de: Allah sagt: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

translations.fr: Allah dit: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.zh: 安拉说: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

text_ar: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۞ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
transliteration: Wa man yattaqillaha yaj'al lahu makhraja

translations.en: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.tr: Kim Allah'a karşı gelmekten sakınırsa, Allah ona bir çıkış yolu ihsan eder.
translations.ar: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۞ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.de: Allah sagt: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.es: Allah dice: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.fr: Allah dit: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.zh: 安拉说: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.

text_ar: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Qul ya 'ibadiyal-ladhina asrafu 'ala anfusihim la taqnatu min rahmatillah

translations.en: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.tr: De ki: Ey kendi aleyhlerine olarak haddi aşan kullarım! Allah'ın rahmetinden ümidinizi kesmeyin.
translations.ar: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.de: Allah sagt: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.es: Allah dice: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.fr: Allah dit: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.zh: 安拉说: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

text_ar: وَلاَ تَهِنُوا وَلاَ تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa la tahinu wa la tahzanu wa antumul-a'lawna in kuntum mu'minin

translations.en: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.tr: Gevşemeyin, hüzünlenmeyin. Eğer inanıyorsanız en üstün olan sizlersiniz.
translations.ar: وَلاَ تَهِنُوا وَلاَ تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.es: Allah dice: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.fr: Allah dit: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.

text_ar: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ
transliteration: La'in shakartum la-azidannakum wa la'in kafartum inna 'adhabi lashadid

translations.en: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.tr: Andolsun ki, eğer şükrederseniz elbette size nimetimi artırırım.
translations.ar: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.de: Allah sagt: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.es: Allah dice: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.fr: Allah dit: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.zh: 安拉说: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.

text_ar: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
transliteration: Wa idha sa'alaka 'ibadi 'anni fa-inni qarib, ujibu da'watad-da'i idha da'an

translations.en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.tr: Kullarım sana beni sorduklarında şüphesiz ben yakınım. Dua edenin duasına icabet ederim.
translations.ar: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.de: Allah sagt: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.es: Allah dice: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.

translations.zh: 安拉说: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.

text_ar: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ
transliteration: Innamal-mu'minunal-ladhina idha dhukirallahu wajilat qulubuhum

translations.en: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.tr: Müminler ancak o kimselerdir ki, Allah anıldığı zaman kalpleri titrer.
translations.ar: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.de: Allah sagt: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.es: Allah dice: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
translations.zh: 安拉说: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.

text_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَى
transliteration: Innallaha ya'muru bil-'adli wal-ihsani wa ita'i dhil-qurba

translations.en: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.tr: Şüphesiz Allah, adaleti, iyilik yapmayı, yakınlara yardım etmeyi emreder.
translations.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَى
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.es: Allah dice: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.

text_ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada

translations.en: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.tr: Rabbimiz! Bize katından bir rahmet ver ve bizim için şu işimizden bir kurtuluş yolu hazırla.
translations.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.es: Allah dice: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.fr: Allah dit: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

text_ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي ۞ وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي ۞ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي ۞ يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
transliteration: Rabbish-rah li sadri wa yassir li amri wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawli

translations.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.tr: Rabbim! Göğsümü genişlet, işimi kolaylaştır, dilimdeki düğümü çöz ki sözümü anlasınlar.
translations.ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي ۞ وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي ۞ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي ۞ يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.de: Allah sagt: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.

translations.fr: Allah dit: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.

translations.ru: Аллах сказал: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.
translations.zh: 安拉说: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue.

text_ar: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa Anta Subhanaka inni kuntu minadh-dhalimin

translations.en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.tr: Senden başka ilâh yoktur. Seni tenzih ederim. Ben gerçekten zalimlerden oldum.
translations.ar: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.de: Allah sagt: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.es: Allah dice: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.fr: Allah dit: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translations.zh: 安拉说: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

text_ar: اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ
transliteration: Allahu nurus-samawati wal-ard

translations.en: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
translations.tr: Allah, göklerin ve yerin nurudur.
translations.ar: اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
translations.es: Allah dice: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
translations.fr: Allah dit: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.

text_ar: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ هَوْنًا
transliteration: Wa 'ibadur-Rahmanil-ladhina yamshuna 'alal-ardi hawna

translations.en: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.tr: Rahmân'ın kulları, yeryüzünde mütevazı bir şekilde yürüyen kimselerdir.
translations.ar: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ هَوْنًا
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.de: Allah sagt: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.es: Allah dice: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.fr: Allah dit: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.
translations.zh: 安拉说: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and gently.

text_ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir

translations.en: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
translations.tr: Rabbim! Doğrusu bana indireceğin her hayra muhtacım.
translations.ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ

translations.zh: 安拉说: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.

text_ar: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا
transliteration: Wal-ladhina jahadu fina lanahdiyannahum subulana

translations.en: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.
translations.tr: Bizim uğrumuzda cihat edenleri elbette kendi yollarımıza eriştireceğiz.
translations.ar: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا

translations.zh: 安拉说: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.

text_ar: يَا بُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا أَصَابَكَ
transliteration: Ya bunayya aqimis-salata wa'mur bil-ma'rufi wanha 'anil-munkari wasbir 'ala ma asabak

translations.en: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.
translations.tr: Yavrum! Namazı kıl, iyiliği emret, kötülükten vazgeçirmeye çalış ve başına gelene sabret.
translations.ar: يَا بُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا أَصَابَكَ

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.
translations.zh: 安拉说: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.

text_ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ
transliteration: Innal-ladhina qalu Rabbunallahu thummas-taqamu tatanazzalu 'alayhimul-mala'ikah

translations.en: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.
translations.tr: Şüphesiz 'Rabbimiz Allah'tır' deyip sonra da dosdoğru olanların üzerine melekler iner.
translations.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.
translations.es: Allah dice: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - angels will descend upon them.

text_ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum

translations.en: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.tr: Allah, O'ndan başka ilâh yoktur; O, hayydır, kayyûmdur.
translations.ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.

translations.ru: Аллах сказал: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.

text_ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۞ إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
transliteration: Fa inna ma'al-'usri yusra. Inna ma'al-'usri yusra

translations.en: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.tr: Şüphesiz zorlukla beraber bir kolaylık vardır.
translations.ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۞ إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
translations.zh: 安拉说: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

text_ar: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
transliteration: Ala bidhikrillahi tatma'innul-qulub

translations.en: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.tr: Bilesiniz ki, kalpler ancak Allah'ı anmakla huzur bulur.
translations.ar: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.es: Allah dice: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

text_ar: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
transliteration: Fadhkuruni adhkurkum washkuru li wa la takfurun

translations.en: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.tr: Öyleyse beni anın ki ben de sizi anayım.
translations.ar: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.de: Allah sagt: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

translations.fr: Allah dit: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
translations.zh: 安拉说: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

text_ar: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۞ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
transliteration: Wa man yattaqillaha yaj'al lahu makhraja

translations.en: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.tr: Kim Allah'a karşı gelmekten sakınırsa, Allah ona bir çıkış yolu ihsan eder.
translations.ar: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۞ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.de: Allah sagt: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.es: Allah dice: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.

translations.id: Allah berfirman: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.
translations.zh: 安拉说: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and provide from where he does not expect.

text_ar: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Qul ya 'ibadiyal-ladhina asrafu 'ala anfusihim la taqnatu min rahmatillah

translations.en: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.tr: De ki: Ey kendi aleyhlerine olarak haddi aşan kullarım! Allah'ın rahmetinden ümidinizi kesmeyin.
translations.ar: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.de: Allah sagt: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.es: Allah dice: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.fr: Allah dit: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
translations.zh: 安拉说: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

text_ar: وَلاَ تَهِنُوا وَلاَ تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa la tahinu wa la tahzanu wa antumul-a'lawna in kuntum mu'minin

translations.en: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.tr: Gevşemeyin, hüzünlenmeyin. Eğer inanıyorsanız en üstün olan sizlersiniz.
translations.ar: وَلاَ تَهِنُوا وَلاَ تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.de: Allah sagt: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.es: Allah dice: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.fr: Allah dit: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.

translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.
translations.zh: 安拉说: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are believers.

text_ar: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ
transliteration: La'in shakartum la-azidannakum wa la'in kafartum inna 'adhabi lashadid

translations.en: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.tr: Andolsun ki, eğer şükrederseniz elbette size nimetimi artırırım.
translations.ar: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.de: Allah sagt: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.es: Allah dice: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.fr: Allah dit: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.id: Allah berfirman: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.ru: Аллах сказал: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.ja: アッラーのお言葉: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.
translations.zh: 安拉说: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor; but if you deny, My punishment is severe.

text_ar: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
transliteration: Wa idha sa'alaka 'ibadi 'anni fa-inni qarib, ujibu da'watad-da'i idha da'an

translations.en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.tr: Kullarım sana beni sorduklarında şüphesiz ben yakınım. Dua edenin duasına icabet ederim.
translations.ar: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
translations.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.fa: کلام الهی: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
translations.de: Allah sagt: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls.
